chapter_title: Concerning the Four Great Days that have come fort

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
The first complete state of illumination is the Divine Itself as the source of truth, the first principle abiding within the living order of heaven. Its full cycle is the entire organization of primary divine operations within that order: the first outgoings brought forth so that the Divine greatness might be received as manifest, arranged throughout the whole ultimate expanse in full completeness, set by discrete degrees in every quarter before the Divine presence.

The second complete state of illumination is the mediating divine operation that communicates between what is highest and what is beneath, abiding in vessels of enlightened knowing in the outer degree. Its full cycle is the entire complement of pure receptive affections of truth called forth within that greatness.

The third complete state of illumination is the universal sustaining stability that serves as boundary and guardian, surpassing all lesser safeguards, holding together what is higher and what is lower and bearing the equilibrium of the whole. Its full cycle is the sufficient complement of operative powers belonging to the good that first engages evil, together with the sufficient complement of operative powers belonging to the living Divine action that rescues and orders, and with them the directed influx and the responsive compliance that complete the series into one whole of light.

The fourth complete state of illumination is divine truth made resplendent within the gathered community of reception. Its full cycle is the full organization of distinct forms of wisdom by which that community is enlightened.

And as there are complete states of illumination, so there are complete states of obscuration.

The first state of obscuration is the realm of active falsity. Within it is a full cycle of darkened perceptions as measured stages of blindness. This fullness is made up of a sufficient series of fundamental falsities pouring out from perverted faculties of sensation and discernment; along with further disorderings that are mixed into those falsities and their extensions; and within them dwell animating persuasions that make the falsities living shadows.

The second state of obscuration is the formative principle of the natural level when separated from heaven, which fabricates delusive appearances and, with them, the whole dominion that rules in falsity. It organizes this dominion through perverted sensory forms arranged as paired impulses within each organized domain, by which falsity and evil conjoin and multiply; together with the burning of self-love and the craving that dwells within corrupted affections and inflames them toward mutual binding.

This same formative intention of spiritual death gave the ruling falsity of that realm and its subordinate persuasions strength for conflict against heaven. Yet that ruling falsity was restrained: it was ensnared through the good that first engages evil, seized through contending persuasions, removed from the state of spiritual death, and compelled into fixed positions of function throughout the universal order, in sufficient divisions set in higher degrees and in lower, together with the opposing inclinations that act as generative forces there—the ardor of self-love and the craving that proceeds from it.

This second obscuration is produced from the first, and it too was restrained through the good that first engages evil. It was drawn up by the living Divine action and fixed within the mixed order in higher and lower degrees, so that its upper aspect operates through distorted sensory forms in the corrupted active principle, and its lower aspect through distorted sensory forms in the corrupted receptive principle.

The third state of obscuration is the full series of corporeal loves in organized forms of both kinds, generated from persuasions set above. These fall into the lowest degree, becoming manifest both in what is devoid of living truth and in what is merely natural truth, together with self-love and craving within them that drive them to conjoin inwardly.

The formative intention of spiritual death is the common origin of them all, and so within those domains it is named as obscuration itself. The organized corporeal loves of both kinds, together with self-love and craving, constitute the full cycle of stages of this third obscuration. This third obscuration, existing in corporeal domains, is begotten from the second, and the living Divine action holds it fixed throughout the universal order in higher and lower degrees so that even what is lowest is compelled into boundaries and uses within a mixed arrangement.

The fourth state of obscuration is evil reigning as law: a dark ruling spirit that speaks and works through a full set of falsified doctrines and divided persuasions. These are evils exposed without any covering of truth, a complete arrangement of delusive generalities produced by the separated natural formative principle; and they are the mind’s seats of judgment, by which that principle is openly expressed as it forms and displays itself in inherited selfhood.

The measured stages of this fourth obscuration—namely the inherited selfhood ruling within divided persuasions—are the full set of evil loves and falsities proceeding from that selfhood. By them the mind sets up distinctions not from life but from deadened discrimination, establishing a rhythm of spiritual death.

These are the states of obscuration that come forth from one another. As the states of illumination stand in ordered succession and make their pattern manifest by degrees, so these states of obscuration also arise in sequence, each brought forth from what preceded it and each making the next possible within the same perverted progression.

paragraph_translations.translation: The first complete state of illumination is the Divine Itself, the God of truth, the first principle abiding within the living order of heaven. The full cycle of this state is the entire organization of the twelve great operations of divine greatness—those first outgoings brought forth so that the Divine greatness might be mirrored in reception—arranged throughout the whole ultimate expanse in complete order, set in every quarter by discrete degrees before the Divine presence.
paragraph_translations.connection: BEGINS the chapter’s account of successive states of illumination by establishing the first and its full cycle.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Twelve hours” and “four climes, three by three” translate smoothly as fullness arranged in ultimates by discrete degrees; no major resistance.

paragraph_translations.translation: The second complete state of illumination is the mediating divine operation that dwells in enlightened vessels in the outer degree and communicates what is above to what is beneath. The full cycle of this state is the complete complement of twelve pure receptive affections of truth called forth within that greatness.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the illumination sequence by introducing a mediating operation and its complete cycle.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Light ship” resists precision; rendered as an outer-degree vessel of knowing that carries and communicates light.

paragraph_translations.translation: The third complete state of illumination is the universal sustaining stability that serves as boundary and guardian, surpassing all lesser safeguards, supporting what is higher and what is lower and bearing the equilibrium of the whole. The full cycle of this state is the sufficient complement of operative powers belonging to the good that first engages evil, together with the sufficient complement of operative powers belonging to the living Divine action that rescues and orders, which together uphold the entire burden of the created arrangement; and with them the directed influx and the responsive compliance that complete the fullness of this operation into one whole series of light.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the sequence by moving from mediation to universal support and equilibrium.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Summons and obedience” translate as directed influx and responsive compliance; “ten brethren” forces a numeric integration—treated as completing the series into twelve.

paragraph_translations.translation: The fourth complete state of illumination is divine truth made resplendent within the gathered community of reception. The full cycle of this state is the full organization of twelve distinct forms of wisdom that constitute its measured stages of light.
paragraph_translations.connection: COMPLETES the set of four illuminations by locating resplendent truth in communal reception.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Church” translated as gathered community of reception; otherwise clean.

paragraph_translations.translation: It was taught that just as there are four complete states of illumination, so there are also four complete states of obscuration.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS from the days of illumination to the nights of obscuration as a parallel series.
paragraph_translations.notes: Speaker (“apostle”) is functionally an instructing voice; no distinct spiritual role is given beyond introducing the parallel.

paragraph_translations.translation: The first state of obscuration is the realm of active falsity. Within it is a complete cycle of twelve darkened perceptions as measured stages of blindness. This fullness consists of a sufficient series of fundamental falsities pouring out from perverted faculties of sensation and discernment; along with further disorderings mixed and bound within those falsities and their extensions; and within them dwell animating persuasions that make the falsities living shadows. These together are the full set of dark stages and their indwelling falsities in the first obscuration.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES by defining the first obscuration and its complete internal structure.
paragraph_translations.notes: The catalog of “elements/sense organs/smokes/spirits” compresses into layers of falsity and animating persuasion; exact one-to-one mapping is uncertain but the functional sense is coherent.

paragraph_translations.translation: The second state of obscuration is the formative principle of the natural level when separated from heaven, which fabricates delusive appearances and shapes the whole dominion that rules within falsity. It composes this dominion through perverted sensory forms arranged as paired impulses in each organized domain, by which falsity and evil conjoin and replicate; together with the burning of self-love and the craving that dwell in corrupted affections and inflame them inwardly toward mutual binding. These are the full set of animating forces in the second obscuration.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by moving from basic falsity to the formative power that organizes it into a ruling order.
paragraph_translations.notes: The “five male and five female, two per world” yields only a general sense of paired active/receptive distortions across domains; exact arithmetic is unclear.

paragraph_translations.translation: This same formative intention of spiritual death gave the ruling falsity of that realm and its subordinate persuasions strength for conflict against heaven. Yet that ruling falsity was restrained: it was ensnared through the good that first engages evil, seized through contending persuasions, removed from the state of spiritual death, and compelled into fixed positions of function throughout the universal order, in sufficient divisions set in higher degrees and in lower, together with the opposing inclinations that act as generative forces in that realm—the ardor of self-love and the craving that proceeds from it.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the second obscuration by describing its attempted assault and subsequent restraint within order.
paragraph_translations.notes: The sentence is damaged in places (“taken to the height… bound”); rendered as restraint and relocation into fixed functions across degrees.

paragraph_translations.translation: This second obscuration is begotten from the first, and it too was restrained through the good that first engages evil. It was drawn up by the living Divine action and fixed within the mixed universal order in higher and lower degrees, so that its upper aspect operates through distorted sensory forms in the corrupted active principle, and its lower aspect through distorted sensory forms in the corrupted receptive principle.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES by summarizing the derivation and structural placement of the second obscuration.
paragraph_translations.notes: The assignment of “upper/male” and “lower/female” is preserved as active/receptive corruption; the precise intended distinction remains somewhat opaque.

paragraph_translations.translation: The third state of obscuration is the full series of corporeal loves in organized domains, in sufficient forms of both kinds, generated from persuasions established above. These fall into the lowest degree and become manifest in what is devoid of living truth and in what is merely natural truth, together with self-love and the craving that dwell within them and drive them inwardly toward conjunction.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by shifting from formative dominion to embodied loves in the lowest degree.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Displayed in what is dry and what is moist” translated as two modes of low-level truthlessness/natural truth; the exact nuance is uncertain.

paragraph_translations.translation: The formative intention of spiritual death is the common origin of them all, and therefore within those domains it is named as obscuration itself. The organized corporeal loves of both kinds, together with self-love and craving, make up the full cycle of twelve measured stages of this third obscuration. This third obscuration, existing in corporeal domains, is begotten from the second, and the living Divine action holds it fixed throughout the universal order in higher and lower degrees so that it is compelled into boundaries and uses within a mixed arrangement.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES by identifying the root of the third obscuration and its restraint within order.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Crucified” translated as fixed/held fast within the universal order; keeps the sense of being forcibly set into a stable boundary-state.

paragraph_translations.translation: The fourth state of obscuration is evil reigning as law: a dark ruling spirit that speaks and works through a complete set of twelve falsified doctrines and divided persuasions. These are evils exposed without any covering of truth, a full arrangement of delusive generalities produced by the separated natural formative principle. They are its seats of judgment, by which it is openly expressed as it forms and displays itself within inherited selfhood.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by moving from corporeal lusts to doctrinal/ideological systems that enthrone evil as law.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Zodiacal signs” resists direct spiritual vocabulary; rendered as a complete arrangement of delusive generalities ordering judgment.

paragraph_translations.translation: The measured stages of this fourth obscuration—namely the inherited selfhood reigning within divided persuasions—are the complete set of evil loves and falsities that proceed from that selfhood. Through them the mind differentiates its states in a fixed rhythm, not by living discernment but by deadened discrimination ordered toward spiritual death.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES by specifying the inner forces and effects of the fourth obscuration.
paragraph_translations.notes: The phrase about differentiating “day and night” is rendered as mental rhythm and discrimination within death; exact mechanism is compressed.

paragraph_translations.translation: This is the fourth obscuration, and these obscurations come forth from one another. As the states of illumination stand in ordered succession and make their pattern manifest by degrees, so these states of obscuration also arise in sequence, each generated from what preceded it and each making the next possible within the same perverted progression.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONCLUDES by asserting the sequential generation of the obscurations in parallel to the illuminations.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: The chapter holds together strongly as a paired sequence: four complete states of illumination followed by four complete states of obscuration, each with a “full cycle” expressed as twelve. The clearest through-line is the movement from Divine source, to mediation, to universal support, to resplendent reception; and then from basic falsity, to formative organization of falsity, to embodied corrupt loves, to doctrinal enthronement of evil. Coherence weakens mainly where damaged text and dense catalogues force compression (especially the second and third nights’ numeric and gendered partitions, and the zodiacal imagery), but the overall voice remains unified as an ordered spiritual cosmology.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent correspondential substrate: the ‘day’ is defined by function (source/principle), and the ‘hours’ arise as functional emanations distributed by a meaningful spatial correspondence (four climes, three-by-three). No narrative seam or foreign jurisdictional administration intrudes.
findings.evidence: Text teaches by function and organic relation: “the Father… the first principle… in his living kingdom. The twelve hours… first evocations… spread out to the four climes, three by three before his face.” The spiritual reading reports it “translate[s] smoothly… no major resistance,” and can explain the correspondence (fullness; distribution into quarters) without inventing external governance.

findings.diagnosis: Mostly correspondential substrate with a mild lexeme-opacity (‘light ship’) that creates interpretive resistance but not a textual disruption. The passage still teaches by function (mediating operation; receptivity as ‘virgins’) rather than by rank/jurisdiction.
findings.evidence: “The second day is the Third Ambassador… dwells in the light ship. His twelve hours are the twelve virgins…” The spiritual reading notes “Light ship resists precision,” but it does not report a narrative break—only difficulty mapping an image. That is typical of a metaphor/technical term, not an administrative insertion.

findings.diagnosis: Mixed voice with a likely seam-expansion: the core is correspondential (Pillar supports above/below; ‘hours’ as supporting powers), but the appended numeration mechanism (“summons and the obedience… counted to their ten brethren”) reads like an institutional/systematizing addendum designed to force a total of twelve, not to advance the functional teaching.
findings.evidence: Core functional teaching is clean: “Pillar of Glory… supports all things… Its twelve hours are the five sons… who support all the weights of the universe.” The stumble happens exactly at the numerical bolt-on: “together with the summons and the obedience, which are counted to their ten brethren.” The spiritual reading explicitly says “ ‘ten brethren’ forces a numeric integration—treated as completing the series into twelve,” i.e., the narrative had to coerce the count rather than derive it from function. That is characteristic of a seam where a later hand harmonizes a list to the chapter’s ‘twelve hours’ scheme by adding an institutional pair (“summons/obedience”) and a counting note (“counted to”).
findings.scope: Remove the numeric-forcing addendum while keeping the functional list: “together with the summons and the obedience, which are counted to their ten brethren.”

findings.diagnosis: Coherent correspondential substrate; the ‘church’ is used as a reception/assembly-image and the ‘twelve wisdoms’ function as forms/stages of illumination. No administrative jurisdiction or named-territory inventory interrupts the line.
findings.evidence: “The fourth day is Jesus the Splendour who dwells in his church. His twelve hours are the twelve wisdoms…” The spiritual reading: “otherwise clean.” Even with the christological naming, the teaching remains functional (resplendent truth in a receptive community; wisdoms as light-hours) rather than a chain-of-command.

findings.diagnosis: Minor framing overlay (dialogue rubric) that does not disrupt the substrate teaching. The shift is a rhetorical hinge (“as four days… so four nights”) and the ‘apostle’ label functions as a redactional speaker-tag rather than an administrative unit.
findings.evidence: “[The apostle spoke to him]: For just as four days exist, so too four nights exist.” The spiritual reading notes the speaker has “no distinct spiritual role… beyond introducing the parallel,” indicating a paratextual/dialogic wrapper. But the chapter’s narrative coherence is strengthened, not broken, by this hinge.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty (dense catalogue) inside an otherwise correspondential passage. The text stacks ‘elements/sense organs/smokes/spirits’ to reach twelve; the reading compresses layers because the micro-mapping is opaque, but there is no voice-switch into governance/jurisdiction.
findings.evidence: “twelve black shadows… five elements… five sense organs… five kinds of smoke… five spirits…” The spiritual reading: “compresses into layers… exact one-to-one mapping is uncertain but the functional sense is coherent.” That is diagnostic of an intact but highly technical correspondential taxonomy (functions of darkness), not an insertion (no ranks, stations, authorities).

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty due to arithmetic/partitioning and possible textual damage, not an administrative intrusion. The passage remains correspondential (Matter as formative principle; sense-organs as functional faculties), but the ‘five male and five female, two per world’ count resists reconstruction.
findings.evidence: “fashioned it in five sense organs… five male and five female, two per world” plus “fire and the lust.” The spiritual reading: “exact arithmetic is unclear.” That is a comprehension stumble stemming from compressed technical numeration (and likely corruption), not a narrative seam: the theme (formative matter organizing embodied dominion) continues uninterrupted into ¶10–11.

findings.diagnosis: Damaged/fragmentary transmission causing syntactic breaks; the narrative logic (ensnarement, elevation, binding, placement above/below) is consistent with the chapter’s functional cosmology, so removal would not improve coherence.
findings.evidence: Visible lacunae/garbling: “Yet, he was caught!… [He] was ta[ken] t[to the height] through the powers [and he was bound] was brought up… and s[et to stand]ove and below…” The spiritual reading flags: “sentence is damaged… rendered as restraint and relocation.” This is classic manuscript damage rather than a voice change.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent correspondential continuation that summarizes derivation (‘begotten from’) and functional placement (‘set… above and below’). The male/ female upper/lower assignment is conceptually opaque but remains within the same functional cosmology, not administrative ordering.
findings.evidence: “begotten from the first… brought up by the hand of the Living Spirit, and set… above and below. The upper side is the sense organs of males; the lower side… females.” The spiritual reading notes opacity but preserves a functional gloss (active/receptive corruption). No new named jurisdictions or ranked inventories appear.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty compounded by internal textual disturbance at ¶12 (variant/duplication ‘five worlds… [ten worlds]’). The teaching remains correspondential (flesh-worlds; dry/moist; lust/fire), and the story flows; the stumble is from an unstable numeral phrase rather than later administrative overlay.
findings.evidence: ¶12 contains an apparent corruption/alternate reading: “The thir[d night is the five] worlds of flesh [ten worlds of flesh,] male, and five female;” which creates immediate uncertainty. The spiritual reading flags uncertainty around “dry and moist” and maintains continuity. Since removing the line would delete the definition of the third night, excision would harm coherence; the problem is damaged numeration, not a foreign voice.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent correspondential teaching with culturally-specific imagery (‘zodiacal signs’) that produces lexical resistance but not narrative rupture. The passage still teaches by function: ‘law of Sin’ as animating dark spirit operating through sects/doctrines; ‘thrones’ as seats/structures of judgment.
findings.evidence: “law of Sin… speaks in the twelve spirits, the twelve sects… twelve zodiacal signs of Matter. They are her thrones.” The spiritual reading notes “ ‘Zodiacal signs’ resists direct spiritual vocabulary,” but it successfully integrates it as an ordering of judgment. No administrative hallmarks (stations, watches, delegated rulers) appear—‘sects’ here function as doctrinal divisions, not jurisdictions.

findings.diagnosis: Damaged line with ellipsis/garble (‘ifferenti[ate]’) causing the reader to compress the mechanism. However, it remains a functional description (how evil powers differentiate experience into a death-rhythm), continuous with ¶14–16; excision would not improve narrative flow.
findings.evidence: Text breaks: “which [that proceed and]fferentiate the day and night [in the rhythm] death.” The spiritual reading: “exact mechanism is compressed.” This looks like transmission damage, not a switch into governance language.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential conclusion that restates the generative sequence (‘come forth… begotten… manifested’) in parallel to the days. It matches the chapter’s organizing principle and resolves the narrative without added administrative apparatus.
findings.evidence: “These are the nights that have come forth of one another… just like the days of light… they manifested one another.” The spiritual reading calls it a “Clean conclusion.” No seam-markers indicating appended systematization beyond the chapter’s own parallelism.

textual_criticism.summary: 12 findings: 1 likely seam-expansion requiring excision (¶4’s ‘summons/obedience… counted to their ten brethren’ numeric-forcing addendum). 3 places of manuscript damage/instability causing interpretive compression (¶10, ¶12–13 numeral duplication, ¶15). The rest reads as coherent correspondential substrate; no standalone administrative overlay blocks were detected.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: The first great day is the Father, the God of truth, the fir[st principle that is a]idst the aeons of his greatness, in his [l]iving kingdom. The twelve hours of this great day are the twelve great rich Gods of greatness. These, who are the first evocations that he evoked (to mirror) his greatness, he spread out to the four climes, three by three before his face.
The second day is the Third Ambassador, the one who dwells in the light ship. His twelve hours are the twelve virgins that he evoked in his greatness.

[The third day is the Pillar of Glory, the great porter that is greater than] all [po]rters; the one that supports all [things], those above and those below. Its twelve hours are the five sons of the First Man; the five sons of the Living Spirit, who support all the weights of the universe; together with the summons and the obedience. These are the twelve light hours of the third day.
The fourth day is Jesus the Splendour who [dwells in] his church. His twelve hours are the twelve wisdoms, which are his [light] h[o]u[rs].
⟨p.26⟩ [The apostle spoke to him]: For just as four day[s ex]ist, s[o] too four nights exist.

The first night is the land of Darkness. It has twelve black [shadows] therein, which are its dark h[o]ur[s]. The twelve shadows of the first night are the five elements of the land of Darkness, [which] poured forth from its five sense organs; and [the five kinds of smoke] which [are mixed and bound] in its [fi]ve elements and its five [sense organs]; the five [sp]irits that dwell in its elements [within them]. These are the twelve shadows and spirits of the first night.

The second night is Matter, the sculptress [of the darknesses] who has sculpted [the bodies] and the entire ruling-power that is in the worl[s of darkness]. She has fashioned it in five sense organs, five [male] and five female, two per world; together with the fire and the lust [that] dwell in men and women, inflaming [them] inward to one another. These are the twelve spirits of this second night.

Indeed she, this Matter, the thought of death, ga[ve] the King of the realms of Darkness and his powers strength for the war and the fight, against the aeons of greatness. Yet, he was caught! They laid a snare for him through the Fi[rst M]an. [He] was ta[ken] t[to the height] through the powers [and he was bound] was brought up from the land of death and s[et to stand]ove and below in the [whole] universe; in the five par[t]s in the heavens above, as well as the five [parts] in the earths below; together with the heat and the cold that are the father and the mother, their fire and their l[u]st.

This is the second night that is begotten from the first night. They laid a snare for her through the First M[a]n. She was brought up by the hand of the Living Spirit, and set in this composite univers[e and set] he[r], above and below. The [upper side is the sense] organs of males; the lower side [is the sense organs of] fe[mal]es.

⟨p.27⟩ The thir[d night is the five] worlds of flesh [ten worlds of flesh,] male, and five female; that were begotten from the powers [abo]ve. They have fallen upon the earth, being displayed in wh[at is d]ry and what is moist; together with the fire and the lust [that d]we[l]l in them, which drives them inward to one another.

[Mat]te[r] herself, the thought of death, is the [mother] of them all; as among them she is named 'the night'. [The worlds] of male and female fleshes, together with the fire and the l[ust], shall [make up the] twelve hours of [this third] night. Again, [it] too, the third night that is in the worlds of fl[e]sh, was begotten from the second night; which the Living [Spir]it crucified in the uni[verse and set]ove and below in heaven [and in earth].

The fourth night is the law of Sin, which is the dark spirit who speaks in the twelve spirits, the twelve sects. They are the nakedne[ss]es, the twelve zodiacal signs of Matter. They are her thrones; she who is made public, as she sculpts and is displayed in the old man.

And, also, the hours of this fourth night that is the old man, who reigns in the sects, are the twelve e[vi]l spirits; the [powers] of the old man, which [that proceed and]fferentiate the day and night [in the rhythm] death.

This is the fourth night [and these are the nights] that have come forth of one another. One has [been begotten] just like the days of lig[ht and] they manifested one another. So als[o in turn] they did arise out of one another.

changes_summary: Implemented Finding 3 (¶4) excision: removed the numeric-forcing addendum “which are counted to their ten brethren” from the clause about “the summons and the obedience,” leaving the functional list intact and minimally coherent. No other changes; all other findings recommended none or annotate-only.
